changelog: Film night now resumes with the next complete episode after the film, never a short tail of the episode before it. Shorter series repeat within a channel cycle until the longest series has completed once, so all configured series remain present through the week. The schedule grid now shows series name and episode title together.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
